test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 29 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following outcomes is NOT caused due to the burning of fossil fuels?

options.text: Formation of oxides of nitrogen and sulphur
Decrease in ozone levels in the upper layers of the atmosphere

solution:
The correct answer is __**Decrease in ozone levels in the upper layers of the atmosphere**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

Fossil fuels:

 
• Fossil fuels are obtained from dead remains of living organisms buried under the earth crust millions of years ago.
 
• Fossil fuels are combustible hydrocarbons formed millions of years ago from the dead decaying plants and animals buried under sediment. 
 
• Over millions of years, these decaying remains of living organisms were covered by layers and layers of silt and buried deep underground. 
 
• The pressure and heat at those depths transformed them into fossil fuels oil, natural gas and coal.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/79e4cff25c17a40918da25a27529290b0414c88167ed704d0ce864f35dd0d4cb.png] 

Thus we can conclude that Fossil fuels are obtained from dead remains of living organisms.
